message.content:
Here is the divided text with summaries for each part:

**Part 1: Introduction to IBM Think 2023 and AI in Business**

The text introduces IBM Think 2023 and highlights the importance of AI in business. It emphasizes that AI in business needs to be held to a higher standard, built to be trusted, secured, and adaptable. The speaker, Dr. Dario Gil, Senior Vice President and Director of Research at IBM, welcomes the audience and expresses his excitement about the possibilities that AI technology will enable. He notes that AI will impact every industry and aspect of our lives.

**Part 2: The Emergence of Foundation Models and Generative AI**

Dr. Gil discusses the emergence of foundation models and generative AI, calling it a defining moment. He advises the audience not to just be AI users, but to be AI value creators. He explains that as an AI value creator, one has control over the model, data, and can train, tune, and deploy models. He introduces Watson X, a new integrated data and AI platform that allows users to become value creators.

**Part 3: Watson X and its Components**

Dr. Gil explains the three primary parts of Watson X: watsonx.data, watsonx.ai, and watsonx.governance. He describes how these components work together seamlessly throughout the entire lifecycle of foundation models. He highlights the importance of hybrid cloud architectures and notes that watsonx is built on top of Red Hat OpenShift.

**Part 4: AI Workflow with Watson X**

Dr. Gil walks the audience through an AI workflow using Watson X, from data preparation to model deployment. He explains how the platform allows users to access and deploy AI workloads in any IT environment. He highlights the importance of data governance and transparency in the AI lifecycle.

**Part 5: Partnership with Hugging Face**

Dr. Gil introduces Claym DeLong, co-founder and CEO of Hugging Face, and they discuss their partnership. Claym shares his background in AI and how Hugging Face got started. He highlights the energy and creativity of the open-source AI community and notes that one model will not rule them all. He expresses his excitement about bringing the power of the open-source community into Watson X.

**Part 6: The Future of AI and Watson X**

Dr. Gil and Claym discuss the future of AI and Watson X. Claym notes that AI is becoming the new default for building all features, workflows, and products. He highlights the expansion of AI into new domains and the importance of chaining different models to build more complex systems. Dr. Gil emphasizes the importance of responsibility and governance in AI development.

**Part 7: Conclusion and Call to Action**

Dr. Gil concludes the presentation by summarizing the key points and announcements made during the event. He encourages the audience to join IBM in embracing the age of value creation with AI. He offers tips for harnessing foundation models, including acting with urgency, being a value creator, betting on community, running everywhere efficiently, and being responsible. He invites the audience to join IBM on this journey and notes that they cannot wait to get started.
